binding_note: v2.1 binds content hashes rather than commit and tree hashes. Commit-hash binding requires a write-read-write bootstrapping sequence; the reviewed candidate, accessibility correction, frozen preview and ratified manifest pin the exact bytes directly, which is what this gate protects.
release_policy: Clinical content is unchanged from the reviewed candidate C4. C5 altered one generated diagram colour token to meet a contrast threshold. The production build changed release-control presentation, the downloads section, and two retired MHRA SmPC addresses whose quoted text was re-verified against the current documents. Verifier identities are not published.
